Scope: source and active filelist entries confirmed. The AIMCP implementation
inspected handles HTTP session-header persistence; this does not establish a
complete MCP operation-body decoder (tools/call, resources/read, etc.). No live
A2A/MCP request, configured listener, protocol conformance, or binary inclusion
